review:
A full-grid Coins game with 36 positions, where nearly all the value is in the Hold the Jackpot bonus. Fill every spot for the 3,000x Grand, with Mini, Minor and Major along the way.

Sticky to Infinity keeps Cluster Collector, Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols in place until the bonus ends, which fills the board faster. Cash Infinity symbols carry 5x to 10x. The Cluster Collector gathers nearby values for up to five spins. High volatility, 96.15% RTP. One for patient grid-fillers.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
